This Service does not address anyone under the age of 13.

Manoharsingh Bhati does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13 years of age. In the case it is discovered that a child under 13 has provided personal information, such information will be immediately deleted.

If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided personal information, please contact Manoharsingh Bhati so that necessary actions can be taken.

Whenever you use the app, in a case of an error in the app, data and information (through third-party products) may be collected automatically on your phone called Log Data. This Log Data may include information such as your device Internet Protocol ("IP") address, device name, operating system version, the configuration of the app when utilizing the Service, the time and date of your use of the Service, and other statistics.

## Cookies

This app does not use "cookies" explicitly. However, the app may use third-party code, libraries, or services that use "cookies" to collect information and improve their services.

You have the option to either accept or refuse these cookies through your device, browser, or third-party service settings. If you choose to refuse cookies, some portions of this Service may be affected.
